name: mermaid
description: Draws the latest ```mermaid block of a reply in a pane, live as it streams (lovely-mermaid)

autoOpen.title: Open the pane on a new diagram
autoOpen.description: Open the Mermaid pane by itself when a reply streams a mermaid block. Off: open it with /mermaid.

view.title: Pane view
view.description: text: Unicode box art. image: a PNG made by mermaid-cli (mmdc), drawn with the kitty graphics protocol; box art while the diagram streams. The pane button switches for the session.

mmdc.title: mermaid-cli command
mmdc.description: The mmdc executable for image view (npm i -g @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli).

imageTheme.title: Image theme
imageTheme.description: auto: dark or light as Claude Code's theme setting says; when that is auto too, as macOS's appearance is. dark / light: always that.
